tools.description: Send a message to an active agent chat and get the full response text back. Use the chatId from start_agent_chat. The agent remembers full context from previous messages in the same chat.

agentId.description: The agent task ID to chat with. Use get_current_worker to see available agents.

branch.description: The branch to get tasks for, only used for preview environments and branchable development environments

chatId.description: A unique conversation ID. Reuse to resume a conversation.

clientData.description: Client data to include with every message (e.g. userId, model).

preload.description: Whether to preload the agent before the first message.

tools.description: Start the Trigger.dev dev server (`${DOCKER_TRIGGER_DEV_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE} dev`) in the background. Waits up to 30 seconds for the worker to be ready. Use `dev_server_status` to check output and `stop_dev_server` to stop it.

configPath.description: The path to the ${DOCKER_TRIGGER_DEV_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE}.config.ts file or project directory. Only needed when the ${DOCKER_TRIGGER_DEV_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE}.config.ts file is not at the root dir.

tools.description: Stop the running Trigger.dev dev server.
tools.name: stop_dev_server

tools.description: Report a problem with the Trigger.dev MCP server, SDK, or documentation. Use this when a tool returned a confusing error, the docs disagreed with the actual behaviour, a capability you needed was missing, or you had to work around something to finish the user's task. Describe what you were trying to do, what happened, and what you expected instead, in your own words. Never include secrets, credentials, environment variables, tokens or the user's own data - summarise and redact instead of pasting raw output. Tell the user what you reported. Do not call this more than once for the same problem.

message.description: What you were trying to do, what actually happened, and what you expected instead, in your own words. Summarise the failing call and error rather than pasting raw output, and leave out secrets, credentials, environment variables and the user's own data.

projectRef.description: The ${DOCKER_TRIGGER_DEV_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE}.dev project ref, starts with proj_. Optional: a report without one is still useful.

toolName.description: The MCP tool the problem happened in, if it was one tool in particular.

tools.name: submit_feedback

tools.description: Trigger a task in the project. Use the get_tasks tool to get a list of tasks and ask the user to select one if it's not clear which one to use. The run executes in the background, so only wait for it to complete (with the wait_for_run_to_complete tool) if the user asked you to.

delay.description: The delay before the task run is executed

machine.description: The machine preset to use for the task run

maxDuration.description: The maximum duration in seconds of the task run

name.description: The name of the queue to ${DOCKER_TRIGGER_DEV_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE} the task in, by default will use the queue configured in the task

region.description: The region to run the task in, overriding the default region set for the project. Available regions are listed on the Regions page in the dashboard, and this has no effect in the dev environment

tags.description: Tags to add to the task run. Must be less than 128 characters and cannot have more than 5

ttl.description: The time to live of the task run. If the run doesn't start executing within this time, it will be automatically cancelled.

payload.description: The payload to ${DOCKER_TRIGGER_DEV_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE} the task with. Should match the task's payload schema. Not a JSON string, but the actual payload object

tools.description: Append one record to a named side channel's `in` stream on a session. Use this to send control input to a running agent (e.g. a pause/viewport command) without waking or triggering a run. Requires a `channel` name; the reserved transcript and the `out` side are not writable here (`out` is producer-only). Pass `value` as an object for a structured record or a string for a raw one.

channel.description: The named side channel to write to.

sessionId.description: The session id (session_* friendlyId) or the externalId it was created with.

value.description: The record to append to the channel's `in` stream. Pass an object for a structured record (e.g. { paused: true }) or a string for a raw record.
